title.narrative: Integrating Living Heritage into Education in the Caribbean SIDS

description.narrative: The project aims to improve educational quality and relevance, while ensuring effective safeguarding of living heritage in Caribbean SIDS. It will focus on strengthening the capacities of key stakeholders in Grenada and Saint Vincent and the Grenadines in integrating living heritage into education practices and policies. To this end, the project will: 1. support teacher training and the development of ICH-encompassing school curriculum in up to 10 pilot schools; 2. launch an awareness campaign in view of supporting knowledge-sharing among stakeholders from the two countries. Beneficiaries will include educators, students in 5th and 6th grades of primary and secondary school, living heritage practitioners, community members and the wider public. Under the overall coordination of the UNESCO Office for the Caribbean and the Living Heritage Entity, the project will be implemented by the Grenada National Commission for UNESCO with the support of the Grenada National Trust, as well as by the Saint Vincent and the Grenadines National Commission for UNESCO, with the support of the Saint Vincent and the Grenadines National Trust.
